guard_streams.source: Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026

facts.detail: The annual statistics cover BDUK-subsidised delivery from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
BDUK estimated delivery to 192,570 premises in 2025/26, 42,280 or 28% more than the prior year.
Cumulative BDUK-subsidised gigabit-capable coverage reached 1,418,410 premises.
Gigabit Infrastructure Subsidy contracts accounted for 72% of annual delivery, or 139,490 premises.
Rural areas accounted for 90% of annual delivery, or 173,190 premises.

guard_streams.source: Bulletin: BDUK delivery performance, quarterly: April 2025 to Sept 2025

facts.detail: BDUK published the April-to-September 2025 quarterly statistics on 13 November 2025.
Estimated delivery was 44,000 premises in Q1 2025/26 and 36,200 in Q2.
Cumulative BDUK gigabit-programme delivery was estimated at 1,307,200 premises.
For the six-month period, GIS represented 71% of delivery, vouchers 18%, and Superfast plus Hubs 11%.
England accounted for 77% of the period's delivery, equal to 61,700 premises.

guard_streams.source: Bulletin: BDUK delivery performance, quarterly: October 2025 to Dec 2025

facts.detail: BDUK published the October-to-December 2025 quarterly statistics on 19 February 2026.
BDUK estimated delivery of gigabit-capable coverage to 56,000 premises during Q3 2025/26.
Cumulative BDUK gigabit-programme delivery was estimated at 1,373,800 premises.
GIS accounted for 75% of quarterly delivery, vouchers 18%, and Superfast plus Hubs 7%.
Residential premises represented 90% of quarterly delivery and commercial premises 10%.

guard_streams.source: Bulletin: BDUK delivery performance, annual: April 2024 to March 2025

facts.detail: BDUK published the 2024/25 annual delivery statistics on 4 September 2025.
The bulletin identifies itself as the first annual release in the official-statistics series.
BDUK estimated delivery of gigabit-capable coverage to 152,700 premises during 2024/25.
Cumulative BDUK gigabit-programme delivery was estimated at 1,227,000 premises.
Rural areas accounted for 89% of 2024/25 delivery, equal to 135,900 premises.

facts.detail: The BDUK Research Portal was published on 16 October 2020 and last updated on 26 June 2026.
The portal collects work from BDUK Evaluation and Analysis teams.
The collection is organised into evaluations, in-house research, evaluation plans and commissioned research.
The research is intended to assess intervention efficacy, inform programme design and understand emerging impacts.
The portal describes a multidisciplinary team including data analysts, modellers, social researchers, economists and designers.
